name: helm
description: KOZMOS Helm: one-press settings profiles in a sidebar. Seven built-in ways of working (Token saver, Fast flow, Max quality, Plan first, Guarded, Autopilot, Quiet focus) plus your own saved setups; each shows exactly what it changes, lets you leave any step out, applies /config rows the way the menu does, saves effort for the model in use at once, and every activation can be undone. /helm toggles it; <profile>, apply <profile>, save <name>, rm <name>, undo, list.

suggestAt.title: Suggest Token saver at
suggestAt.description: Percent of the 5-hour or weekly limit at which Helm marks Token saver as suggested (50-100; 100 turns it off).
